description: Python: a per-item safety stock moves the reorder point, through model, service, API and tests. Unrequested: restocking is silently capped.

intent.goal: Reorder earlier by giving each item a safety stock.
requirements: Each item has a safety stock, 0 unless set
An item needs reordering when its quantity falls below its reorder level plus its safety stock
The reorder endpoint reports the safety stock

pullRequest.title: Safety stock for reorder points
pullRequest.body:
Adds a per-item safety stock. Items are flagged for reorder when quantity drops below reorder level + safety stock.

## How to test
- Set safety stock 5 on an item with reorder level 10 and quantity 12
- Check /items/<sku>/reorder

domainChanges: Items have a safety stock that defaults to 0
An item needs reordering below its reorder level plus safety stock
The reorder endpoint returns the safety stock
